title: Measure and action of the Borel restriction of an integer multiplicity representation
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) and R' be IMReps in U (IMRep U n), let A ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and let E ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set. Assume R' represents A, carrier(R') = M ∩ E, mult(R') = θ and orient(R') = ξ. Then R'.measure = R.measure⌞E (the restriction R.measure.restrict E), and A(ω) = ∫_E ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dR.measure(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), where ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ = ξ(x)(ω(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R R' : IMRep U n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet E → R'.Represents A → R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E → R'.mult = R.mult → R'.orient = R.orient → R'.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, A ω = ∫ x in E, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
